about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a senior full stack developer who bridges the gap between design and engineering. My approach is product-first: every line of code serves a business goal.
about.paragraph2: I've spent the last 4+ years building applications that users love and businesses rely on. From early-stage startups to enterprise platforms, I've seen what works—and what doesn't.
about.paragraph3: What sets me apart? I think like a product builder, not just a coder. I ask "why" before "how", prioritize impact over complexity, and ship with confidence.

lexya.description: Major overhaul of a leading textbook e-commerce platform in Quebec.
lexya.seoDescription: Complete redesign and rebuild of Lexya’s textbook e‑commerce platform in Quebec, focused on performance, UX, and scalable content management.
lexya.longDescription: Close collaboration with MamboMambo agency to transform Lexya's visual identity into a cutting-edge digital experience. Orchestrated the transition to PayloadCMS and Next.js for total editorial flexibility and peak performance.
lexya.impact: Modernized technical architecture, enabling seamless content management and an ultra-fast shopping experience.

achete_ton_cell.description: Hybrid e-commerce ecosystem linking online store and physical retail locations.
achete_ton_cell.seoDescription: Custom Shopify ecosystem connecting online and in‑store sales, optimized for conversion, inventory sync, and retail operations.

achete_ton_cell.impact: Unified the customer experience between Web and physical retail, optimized through precise conversion data analysis.

hockey_academie.description: Specialized e-commerce and booking platform for elite sports training.

optimize_id.description: High-performance showcase site for a branding and visual identity agency.
